metrics.label: Games
metrics.desc: Games with a plate appearance.

metrics.label: PA
metrics.desc: Plate appearances.

metrics.label: AB
metrics.desc: At-bats: PA minus walks, HBP, sacrifices and catcher's interference.

metrics.label: H
metrics.desc: Hits.

metrics.label: 1B
metrics.desc: Singles.

metrics.label: 2B
metrics.desc: Doubles.

metrics.label: 3B
metrics.desc: Triples.

metrics.label: HR
metrics.desc: Home runs.

metrics.label: BB
metrics.desc: Walks (unintentional).

metrics.label: IBB
metrics.desc: Intentional walks.

metrics.label: HBP
metrics.desc: Hit by pitch.

metrics.label: SO
metrics.desc: Strikeouts.

metrics.label: SF
metrics.desc: Sacrifice flies.

metrics.label: SH
metrics.desc: Sacrifice bunts.

metrics.label: GIDP
metrics.desc: Grounded into double play.

metrics.label: AVG
metrics.desc: H / AB.

metrics.label: OBP
metrics.desc: (H + BB + IBB + HBP) / (AB + BB + IBB + HBP + SF).

metrics.label: SLG
metrics.desc: Total bases / AB.

metrics.label: OPS
metrics.desc: OBP + SLG.

metrics.label: ISO
metrics.desc: SLG - AVG.

metrics.label: BABIP
metrics.desc: (H - HR) / (AB - SO - HR + SF).

metrics.label: wOBA
metrics.desc: Savant's woba_value summed over woba_denom: linear weights of each PA result, scaled to OBP.

metrics.label: K%
metrics.desc: Strikeouts per PA.

metrics.label: BB%
metrics.desc: Walks (incl. intentional) per PA.

metrics.label: BB/K
metrics.desc: Walks per strikeout.

metrics.label: HR/PA
metrics.desc: Home runs per PA.

metrics.label: XBH/PA
metrics.desc: Extra-base hits per PA.

metrics.label: HBP%
metrics.desc: Hit by pitch per PA.

metrics.label: Swing%
metrics.desc: Swings per pitch.

metrics.label: Zone% seen
metrics.desc: Share of pitches seen in the strike zone (Savant zones 1-9).

metrics.label: Z-Swing%
metrics.desc: Swings at pitches in the zone.

metrics.label: Chase%
metrics.desc: Swings at pitches outside the zone (O-Swing%).

metrics.label: Contact%
metrics.desc: Contact (fouls and balls in play) per swing.

metrics.label: Z-Contact%
metrics.desc: Contact per swing in the zone.

metrics.label: O-Contact%
metrics.desc: Contact per swing outside the zone.

metrics.label: Whiff%
metrics.desc: Swinging strikes (incl. foul tips) per swing.

metrics.label: SwStr%
metrics.desc: Swinging strikes per pitch.

metrics.label: Called strike%
metrics.desc: Called strikes per pitch seen.

metrics.label: CSW% against
metrics.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per pitch.

metrics.label: First-pitch swing%
metrics.desc: Swings at the first pitch of a PA.

metrics.label: First-pitch strike% seen
metrics.desc: First pitches that were strikes (called, swinging, foul or in play).

metrics.label: Pitches/PA
metrics.desc: Pitches seen per plate appearance.

metrics.label: Two-strike whiff%
metrics.desc: Whiffs per swing with two strikes.

metrics.label: Heart swing%
metrics.desc: Swings at pitches in the heart of the zone (attack zones).

metrics.label: Chase-zone swing%
metrics.desc: Swings in the chase band (133-200 % of the zone).

metrics.label: Waste swing%
metrics.desc: Swings at waste pitches (beyond 200 % of the zone).

metrics.label: Decision value
metrics.desc: Runs gained by swing/take choices alone (swing model, centred on the league): for every pitch, the run value of the choice made minus the expected value of the league's swing probability there; contact quality is excluded.

metrics.label: Decision value /100
metrics.desc: Decision value per 100 pitches.

metrics.label: Zone decisions
metrics.desc: Decision value on pitches in the zone.

metrics.label: Chase decisions
metrics.desc: Decision value on pitches outside the zone.

metrics.label: Expected swing%
metrics.desc: The league swing probability for the pitches he saw (location, count, pitch shape).

metrics.label: Swing% over expected
metrics.desc: Swing% minus expected swing%: aggression beyond what the pitches called for.

metrics.label: Bad-take rate
metrics.desc: Share of his takes on which swinging had the higher expected run value (lower is better).

metrics.label: Bad-swing rate
metrics.desc: Share of his swings on which taking had the higher expected run value.

metrics.label: Exit velocity
metrics.desc: Mean exit velocity on balls in play.

metrics.label: EV90
metrics.desc: 90th percentile exit velocity.

metrics.label: Max EV
metrics.desc: Hardest-hit ball.

metrics.label: Launch angle
metrics.desc: Mean launch angle.

metrics.label: Launch angle SD
metrics.desc: Spread of launch angles (lower = more consistent).

metrics.label: Hard-hit%
metrics.desc: Balls in play at 95+ mph.

metrics.label: Barrel%
metrics.desc: Barrels (Savant launch_speed_angle 6: the speed/angle combinations worth a .500 AVG and 1.500 SLG) per ball in play.

metrics.label: Barrels/PA
metrics.desc: Barrels per plate appearance.

metrics.label: Sweet-spot%
metrics.desc: Launch angle 8-32 degrees.

metrics.label: Solid contact%
metrics.desc: launch_speed_angle 5.

metrics.label: Flare/burner%
metrics.desc: launch_speed_angle 4.

metrics.label: Under%
metrics.desc: launch_speed_angle 3: hit under.

metrics.label: Topped%
metrics.desc: launch_speed_angle 2.

metrics.label: Weak%
metrics.desc: launch_speed_angle 1.

metrics.label: HR distance
metrics.desc: Mean projected home-run distance.

metrics.label: Fly-ball distance
metrics.desc: Mean distance of fly balls.

metrics.label: Longest ball
metrics.desc: Longest projected distance.

metrics.label: xwOBA+ (ours)
metrics.desc: Our expected wOBA: each ball in play scored from exit velocity, launch angle, hang time, the park (its five fence distances, mean wall height, elevation and roof) and sprint speed; walks, HBP and strikeouts at their wOBA values.

metrics.label: xwOBA+ (park-neutral)
metrics.desc: xwOBA+ with every ball re-scored in a standard park (330/375/400 ft, 8 ft walls, median elevation, open roof).

metrics.label: xwOBA (Savant)
metrics.desc: Savant's xwOBA (estimated_woba_using_speedangle on balls in play).

metrics.label: xwOBA+ minus xwOBA (Savant)
metrics.desc: xwOBA+ minus Savant's xwOBA: what hang time, the park and sprint speed add to exit velocity and launch angle.

metrics.label: wOBA minus xwOBA+
metrics.desc: Results above expectation (positive = outperforming contact quality; regresses).

metrics.label: xBA
metrics.desc: Savant expected batting average.

metrics.label: xSLG
metrics.desc: Savant expected slugging.

metrics.label: xwOBAcon+
metrics.desc: xwOBA+ on balls in play.

metrics.label: xwOBAcon (Savant)
metrics.desc: Savant's xwOBA on balls in play.

metrics.label: GB%
metrics.desc: Ground balls per ball in play.

metrics.label: LD%
metrics.desc: Line drives.

metrics.label: FB%
metrics.desc: Fly balls.

metrics.label: PU%
metrics.desc: Pop-ups.

metrics.label: Pull%
metrics.desc: Spray angle more than 15 degrees to the pull side.

metrics.label: Straightaway%
metrics.desc: Within 15 degrees of centre.

metrics.label: Oppo%
metrics.desc: More than 15 degrees to the opposite field.

metrics.label: Pull-air%
metrics.desc: Pulled line drives and fly balls per ball in play (the most valuable batted-ball direction).

metrics.label: Oppo-air%
metrics.desc: Opposite-field line drives and fly balls.

metrics.label: HR/FB
metrics.desc: Home runs per fly ball.

metrics.label: Bat speed
metrics.desc: Mean bat speed (sweet spot, competitive swings with 50+ mph).

metrics.label: Adjusted bat speed
metrics.desc: Bat speed relative to the expectation for his pitches (count, location, pitch speed), shrunk with 50 swings, plus the league mean.

metrics.label: Fast-swing%
metrics.desc: Swings at 75+ mph.

metrics.label: Swing length
metrics.desc: Distance the bat head travels (ft).

metrics.label: Adjusted swing length
metrics.desc: Swing length relative to the expectation for his pitches.

metrics.label: Squared-up% (contact)
metrics.desc: Contact with 80 %+ of the attainable exit velocity (1.23 bat speed + 0.23 pitch speed).

metrics.label: Squared-up% (swing)
metrics.desc: Squared-up per swing.

metrics.label: Squared-up over expected
metrics.desc: Squared-up rate minus the model's expectation for the pitches he made contact with.

metrics.label: Attack angle
metrics.desc: Vertical angle of the bat's path at contact.

metrics.label: Path mismatch
metrics.desc: Mean |attack angle + pitch VAA|: how far his swing plane is from the pitch plane.

metrics.label: Path matched%
metrics.desc: Swings within 5 degrees of the pitch plane.

metrics.label: Attack direction
metrics.desc: Horizontal angle of the bat path (+ toward the pull side).

metrics.label: Swing-path tilt
metrics.desc: Tilt of the swing plane.

metrics.label: Contact point (rel.)
metrics.desc: Intercept point in front of the body relative to the league (in; + = out front).

metrics.label: xwOBA v fastballs
metrics.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with fastballs.

metrics.label: Whiff% v fastballs
metrics.desc: Whiffs per swing v fastballs.

metrics.label: Run value/100 v fastballs
metrics.desc: Batting run value (Savant delta_run_exp) per 100 fastballs seen.

metrics.label: Chase% v fastballs
metrics.desc: Swings at fastballs outside the zone.

metrics.label: xwOBA v breaking balls
metrics.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with breaking balls.

metrics.label: Whiff% v breaking balls
metrics.desc: Whiffs per swing v breaking balls.

metrics.label: Run value/100 v breaking balls
metrics.desc: Batting run value (Savant delta_run_exp) per 100 breaking balls seen.

metrics.label: Chase% v breaking balls
metrics.desc: Swings at breaking balls outside the zone.

metrics.label: xwOBA v offspeed
metrics.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with offspeed.

metrics.label: Whiff% v offspeed
metrics.desc: Whiffs per swing v offspeed.

metrics.label: Run value/100 v offspeed
metrics.desc: Batting run value (Savant delta_run_exp) per 100 offspeed seen.

metrics.label: Chase% v offspeed
metrics.desc: Swings at offspeed outside the zone.

metrics.label: xwOBA v 95+ mph
metrics.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with a pitch at 95+ mph.

metrics.label: Whiff% v 95+ mph
metrics.desc: Whiffs per swing at 95+ mph.

metrics.label: xwOBA v 90-95 mph
metrics.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with a pitch at 90-95 mph.

metrics.label: Whiff% v 90-95 mph
metrics.desc: Whiffs per swing at 90-95 mph.

metrics.label: xwOBA v under 90 mph
metrics.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with a pitch at under 90 mph.

metrics.label: Whiff% v under 90 mph
metrics.desc: Whiffs per swing at under 90 mph.

metrics.label: Run value/100 (heart)
metrics.desc: Batting run value per 100 pitches in the heart attack zone.

metrics.label: Run value/100 (shadow)
metrics.desc: Batting run value per 100 pitches in the shadow attack zone.

metrics.label: Run value/100 (chase)
metrics.desc: Batting run value per 100 pitches in the chase attack zone.

metrics.label: Run value/100 (waste)
metrics.desc: Batting run value per 100 pitches in the waste attack zone.

metrics.label: Shadow swing%
metrics.desc: Swings at pitches on the edges (shadow attack zone).

metrics.label: wOBA v LHP
metrics.desc: wOBA against left-handed pitchers.

metrics.label: wOBA v RHP
metrics.desc: wOBA against right-handed pitchers.

metrics.label: xwOBA v LHP
metrics.desc: Savant xwOBA v LHP.

metrics.label: xwOBA v RHP
metrics.desc: Savant xwOBA v RHP.

metrics.label: K% v LHP
metrics.desc: Strikeouts per PA v LHP.

metrics.label: K% v RHP
metrics.desc: Strikeouts per PA v RHP.

metrics.label: PA share v LHP
metrics.desc: Share of his PAs against left-handers.

metrics.label: Platoon gap
metrics.desc: |wOBA v same-handed pitchers - wOBA v opposite-handed| (switch hitters: |v LHP - v RHP|).

metrics.label: WPA
metrics.desc: Win probability added: the change in our win expectancy (Markov model on inning, half, outs, bases, score) over his PAs.

metrics.label: WPA/LI
metrics.desc: Context-neutral wins: sum of WPA / leverage.

metrics.label: Clutch
metrics.desc: WPA / pLI - WPA/LI (FanGraphs' definition).

metrics.label: pLI
metrics.desc: Average leverage index of his PAs (1 = average).

metrics.label: RE24
metrics.desc: Run expectancy added over his PAs (runs).

metrics.label: RE24/PA
metrics.desc: RE24 per plate appearance.

metrics.label: wOBA high leverage
metrics.desc: wOBA in PAs with LI >= 1.5.

metrics.label: Sprint speed
metrics.desc: Savant sprint speed (ft/s, top two-thirds of competitive runs).

metrics.label: Home to first
metrics.desc: Savant home-to-first time (s).

metrics.label: Baserunning runs
metrics.desc: Steals (wSB) plus extra bases taken on hits against the league for the same hit, base and outs (builder C).

metrics.label: wSB
metrics.desc: Stolen-base runs above average (FanGraphs' constants).

metrics.label: Extra-base runs
metrics.desc: Runs from taking extra bases on hits.

metrics.label: SB (est.)
metrics.desc: Stolen bases detected in the pitch data (estimated).

metrics.label: CS (est.)
metrics.desc: Caught stealing detected in the pitch data (estimated).

metrics.label: OAA
metrics.desc: Outs above average from our catch-probability model (landing spot, hang time, alignment-inferred start).

metrics.label: Fielding runs
metrics.desc: OAA converted to runs with the season's linear weights.

metrics.label: Success rate added
metrics.desc: OAA per chance.

metrics.label: OAA going back
metrics.desc: OAA on plays moving back.

metrics.label: OAA coming in
metrics.desc: OAA on plays moving in.

metrics.label: OAA toward 3B
metrics.desc: OAA moving toward the third-base line.

metrics.label: OAA toward 1B
metrics.desc: OAA moving toward the first-base line.

metrics.label: Savant OAA
metrics.desc: Savant's published outs above average (for comparison).

metrics.label: Arm strength
metrics.desc: Savant arm strength (top throws, mph).

metrics.label: Framing runs
metrics.desc: Catchers: called strikes added over the league surface (location, count, pitch, umpire, pitcher, batter effects) times the run value of a strike.

metrics.label: Strike rate added
metrics.desc: Catchers: strikes added per called pitch.

metrics.label: WAR
metrics.desc: Bullpen WAR (regressed): (batting + baserunning + fielding + framing + positional + league + replacement runs) / runs per win, with batting from regressed park-neutral xwOBA+.

metrics.label: WAR (results)
metrics.desc: Bullpen WAR with results-based batting runs (wOBA, park-adjusted) in place of the regressed xwOBA+ batting runs.

metrics.label: RAR
metrics.desc: Runs above replacement.

metrics.label: Batting runs
metrics.desc: True-talent batting runs: park-neutral xwOBA+ regressed with the stabilisation PA, against the league, per PA.

metrics.label: Batting runs (results)
metrics.desc: Results-based batting runs (wOBA, park-adjusted).

metrics.label: Positional runs
metrics.desc: Positional adjustment prorated by games at each position.

metrics.label: Replacement runs
metrics.desc: Replacement level credited per PA.

metrics.label: WAR/600
metrics.desc: WAR per 600 plate appearances.

metrics.label: Projected wOBA
metrics.desc: Next-season wOBA from the component projections (each skill regressed at its own rate, aging applied).

metrics.label: Projected ISO
metrics.desc: Projected isolated power.

metrics.label: Projected BABIP
metrics.desc: Projected BABIP.

metrics.label: Projected K%
metrics.desc: Projected strikeout rate.

metrics.label: Projected BB%
metrics.desc: Projected walk rate.

metrics.label: Projected HR/PA
metrics.desc: Projected home runs per PA.

metrics.label: Preseason projected wOBA
metrics.desc: The projection made before this season from earlier seasons only.
